synthesis.procedure: Dissolve YCl3·6H2O in water, add aqueous Na2CO3 dropwise with stirring, heat to 80 °C, add Na8H[PW9O34] rapidly with vigorous stirring, and stir for 1 h at 80 °C. Cool, centrifuge off insoluble material, add NaCl, and allow the solution to stand. Keep crystals wet for the 42-hydrate structure.
